text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it carefully. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay focused until lunchtime. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, and plan the next day. I believe consistency is the key to a good routine, so I try to keep the same schedule every day. It helps me feel calm and productive.
